units.summary: CompactStaleHead now delegates block writing and eviction to the shared compactHeadViewLocked helper, using NewSelectedSeriesHead and truncateStaleSeries with an append-ID watermark. This changes which series get evicted (those that got newer samples are skipped), the chunk-range loop bound, and the error messages.
units.headline: Stale head compaction reuses shared helper with append-ID eviction watermark
units.reason: Persistence and eviction logic moved into a shared helper with new watermark semantics, so stale-series data-loss behavior must be judged.
focus: Series that received samples after the watermark are now skipped, not evicted
Stale-series hint still set on every block written
The `start` variable and metrics are still set up before the new return path
Loop bound inclusive change does not write extra empty blocks

units.summary: Blocks tagged from-selected-series are now excluded from the in-order max time, like stale and out-of-order blocks. This value drives the WAL-replay cutoff and head truncation, so it affects data retention on reload.
units.headline: In-order max time now ignores selected-series blocks
units.reason: Changes the cutoff used for head truncation and WAL replay, where a wrong value silently loses data.
focus: Merged blocks keep the selected hint so they stay excluded (CompactBlockMetas)
Existing on-disk blocks without the hint behave as before

units.summary: Removes TestStaleBlockNotMergedWithNonStaleBlock and TestOutOfOrderBlockMergePreservesHint from this location. Both are re-added later in the PR in db_test.go with only the doc comment changed, so this is a move and coverage is kept.
units.headline: Two merge-hint tests moved lower in db_test.go
units.reason: Test-only deletion, but the same tests reappear elsewhere in the PR with the same bodies, so no coverage is lost.

units.summary: Only a comment changes, renaming the referenced function from gcStaleSeries to gcSeries. Test logic and assertions are untouched.
units.headline: Test comment updated to reference gcSeries
units.reason: Comment-only edit in a test file; no code or assertion changes.

units.summary: New test checking that a block written by CompactSelectedSeries carries the selected hint and is not counted by inOrderBlocksMaxTime. It only adds coverage for the new exclusion.
units.headline: New test: selected-series blocks excluded from in-order max time
units.reason: New test-only code that cannot affect production behavior.
